action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.74, no seasonality) with unstable model rankings (Kendall tau -0.23) and heavy correlated-error redundancy (only 3 independent groups among 19 models). turns.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.74, no seasonality) with unstable model rankings (Kendall tau -0.23) and heavy correlated-error redundancy (only 3 independent groups among 19 models). In this regime, a plain mean over the full pool provides maximum diversification of independent trend estimates without chasing window-specific noise. Thirteen alternative strategies—pool subsets, trimmed means, inverse-error weights, per-horizon weights, pruned pools, DBA—none improved on the simple mean, confirming that the redundancy and instability make any selective or fitted weighting counterproductive.
